encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: Β. ἀνδραπόδι᾽ ἤδη ταῦθ᾽, ὁρᾶς; Α. ἥκιστά γε,
ἐκπωμάτων δ᾽ ὀνόματα. Β. πρὸς τῆς Ἑστίας;
Α. ὁ λαβρώνιος χρυσῶν δέ, παῖδες, εἴκοσιν.

note.p: Athenaeus 11, 484e Δίφιλος Τιθραύστῃ καὶ ἄλλα γένη καταλέγων ποτηρίων φησί κτλ. et 484 a βατιάκιον, λαβρώνιος, τραγέλαφος, πρίστις ποτηρίων ὀνόματα.

1. πρ. τρ. Iacobs. Add. Ath. 261] τρ. πρ. A. 2. ἀνδραπόδι᾽ ἤδη Dobr.] ἀνδραπόδιον δὴ A. ἀνδραποδίων δὴ Dalecamp. at pro servis haec habere nemo poterat. Hipparch. 3 ὁ λαβρώνιος avis esse creditur. itaque τραγελάφου potissimum ratione habita scribendum arbitror τετράποδα δ᾽ ἤδη κτλ. — ceterum non πρίστιν, sed πρῆστιν Graecos dixisse existimo (a πρήθειν) piscem, qui aquam balenarum modo ex naribus efflaret.
